executive_summary.narrative: Meridian Platform's billing exports reveal 131 primary revenue leakage findings totaling $821,178 in recoverable ARR against a $27M subscription base (3.0% of run-rate ARR). The largest concentrations are expired promotional discounts still billing after the EOY25 campaign, legacy catalog pricing after the July 2024 price increase, and invoice execution drift on renewals. Each finding includes subscription-level evidence and a recommended remediation path.

findings.title: Cancelled Subscription Still Billing
findings.recommendation: Stop billing cancelled subscriptions and review erroneous invoices.
